info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Polybas Battery Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Polybas Battery Detail Management API allows users to create detailed records for Polybas battery products within the catalog. This endpoint is crucial for businesses looking to enhance their inventory by adding comprehensive specifications and information relevant to their battery offerings. Typical consumers include product managers and inventory specialists who aim to maintain an up-to-date product catalog. Using this API, organizations can ensure accurate representation of their battery products, helping improve visibility and customer choices.

post.summary: Create new polybas battery detail entry.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new entry for polybas battery details, providing necessary specifications and characteristics needed for effective battery management.

requestBody.description: Request body for creating or updating the details of a Polybas battery. This includes necessary parameters to accurately represent the state of the battery, such as specifications and operational details.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the details are returned.

polybas_battery_id.description: The unique identifier for the polybas battery.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person or entity requesting the battery.

isPriority.description: Indicates if the request is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the battery.

supplier.description: Information about the supplier of the battery.

CreateCatalogPolybasBatteryDetailRequest.description: The request body for creating or updating polybas battery details.

unit.description: The unit of measurement for the dimensions, e.g., 'cm' or 'inches'.

Dimensions.description: The dimensions of the battery including width, height, and unit of measurement.

verified.description: Indicates if the supplier has been verified.

Supplier.description: Information about the supplier of the battery including name, verification status, and contact information.

email.description: The email address for contacting the supplier.

phone.description: The phone number for contacting the supplier.

Contact.description: Contact information for the supplier including email and phone number.

CreateCatalogPolybasBatteryDetailRespons.title: Battery Operation Response

recordId.description: The unique identifier for the record created or modified.

processedAt.description: The timestamp when the processing was completed.

matchedCount.description: The count of matched records processed during the operation.

pricing.description: Details regarding the pricing for the operation.

CreateCatalogPolybasBatteryDetailRespons.description: Schema representing the response returned after a successful battery operation.

PricingDetails.title: Pricing Details

net.description: The net amount before any taxes are applied.

currency.description: The currency in which the pricing is specified.

taxIncluded.description: Indicates whether the tax is included in the pricing.

PricingDetails.description: Schema representing the pricing information for an operation.

content-type.description: Indicates the media type of the resource being returned. Typically 'application/json' for JSON responses.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds. This value helps in understanding the performance of the API.
